name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task 'Carry the box to the exit' requires holding the box when reaching the exit. This corresponds to a `Existence(at_exit)` goal combined with a `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` rule. The candidate only includes `Existence(at_exit)`, which allows the agent to reach the exit without holding the box (and thus fails the 'Carry' requirement). The compiled machine reflects this by allowing transitions to `FINAL_STATES` (u2) on `at_exit & !box_fell` regardless of `holding_box`. Add a hard `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` clause. Keep `Existence(at_exit)` and ensure it is linked with the box-holding condition.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses accurately encode reaching the exit while holding the box and recovering from drops as required by the task.

texts: Hold the box when reaching the exit
Whenever the box falls, pick it up again
machine:
